claim_scope: Nonconstant finite Dirichlet-polynomial Volterra symbols acting on the unweighted Hilbert Hardy space of Dirichlet series. Exact leading singular-value asymptotic, exponential small-threshold counting law, and explicit nontrivial example.
integrity: Explicit analytic proof and reproducible finite consistency checks are included; no independent audit or proof certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Not extended to infinite symbols, weighted Bergman spaces, or non-Hilbert exponents. Finite checks are supplementary. Novelty is a best-knowledge literature assessment; independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp logarithmic singular-value law for polynomial Dirichlet Volterra operators
